applications.name: AIPA Order Entry
applications.title: AIPA Order Entry / Blotter
applications.description: Signs demo.order / demo.orderList drafts for human review; blotter for ViewOrders.

demo.CreateOrder.purpose: Accept a demo.order or demo.orderList, sign it, and add it to the blotter for human review.

ViewOrders.purpose: Show the order blotter filtered to a selected instrument.

demo.SubmitOrder.purpose: After human review, submit the blotter as a demo.order or demo.orderList to Execution.
